# Lubby's Locs

> Loc salon in North Tampa, Florida (1323 W Busch Blvd, Suite D, Tampa, FL 33612). Starter locs, instant locs, retwists, loc repair and reattachments, loc styling, color, braids, a kids menu and a barber menu, plus one-on-one loc classes with Lubby. In the business's words: "We specialize in haircare for the loc society." Booksy tagline: "A salon for all Kinks, coils, braids and locs!"

## Key facts

- Name: Lubby's Locs (listed on Booksy as "Lubbys Locs")
- Address: 1323 W Busch Blvd, Suite D, Tampa, FL 33612 (North Tampa, on West Busch Blvd)
- Phone (call or text): (813) 520-1648
- Website: https://lubbys-locs-tampa.netlify.app/
- Book online: https://booksy.com/en-us/650812_lubbys-locs_braids-locs_15761_tampa
- Shop (Square store): https://lubbys-locs.square.site/s/shop
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lubbyslocs
- Hours: by appointment. Live availability is on Booksy. Call or text for appointments during closed hours; a $25 non-refundable convenience fee deposit applies.
- Ratings: 4.9 from 181 Google reviews; 5.0 from 305 Booksy reviews (486 reviews combined).
- Amenities (per Booksy): parking, wheelchair accessible, child-friendly, Wi-Fi, credit cards accepted, loyalty program.
- Policies: $25 deposit required at booking (deducted at checkout; non-refundable for cancellation, no-show or lateness). 15 minutes or more late without texting or calling may require rescheduling. Unbooked extra services may be declined or charged a $40 inconvenience fee.
- New clients: New client appointment $115 (2h 15min: introduction, complete consultation and recommendations, wash, condition, palm-roll retwist, basic style) or Consultation $30 (30min).

## Full service menu (prices from Booksy, Oct 12, 2026; "+" means starting price)

### New to Lubby's Locs
- New client appointment: $115 (2h 15min). Introduction to Lubby's Locs, a complete consultation and recommendations for your hair, plus wash, condition, palm-roll retwist and a basic style. Repairs are priced at the consult.
- Consultation: $30 (30min). A planning conversation about your hair-care needs and goals.
- Starter Locs comb twist: $150+ (2h). Consult required. Price depends on size, length and parting.
- Starter Locs two strand twist method: $200+ (2h). Consult required.
- Starter locs interlocking: $600+ (5h). Consult required.
- Instant Locs half head: $400+ (3h). Consult required. Above-shoulder start. Large $400, medium $500, small $600.
- Instant locs on Interlocked roots: $700+ (5h)
- Loc extensions half head: $500+ (5h)
- Instant Locs Full head: $600+ (6h). Consult required. Large $600, medium $700, small $800.
- Loc extensions full head: $1,000+ (4h). Consult required.
- Two week follow up for Starter locs: $60 (2h). Check-up and adjustments for new starter locs.

### Retwists & Styles
- Wash+ Retwist Full head shoulders up: $90 (2h). Basic style or stylist's choice included.
- Wash+ Retwist full head mid back: $100 (2h)
- Wash retwist & two strand rope twist: $130+ (2h 30min). Wash and retwist (shoulders up) plus two strand twisted locs.
- Retwist locs box top: $70 (1h)
- Loc Detox: $40 (30min)
- Interlocking: $135+ (2h). Higher if locs are past the shoulders or 100+ smaller locs.
- Interlocking half head: $95 (2h)
- Rope twist/ Extended Weave Styles on locs only!: $150+ (2h). Hair added for length. Lasts 4 to 6 weeks.
- Wash, retwist, Pipe cleaner curls: $150 (2h 30min)
- Finger coils: $100+ (1h)
- Two strand twist natural hair: $85+ (2h 30min)
- Loc Bob: $150 (2h 30min)
- Boho twist on locs: $250 (4h). Temporary curly hair added in pieces to twisted or braided locs.
- Steam treatment: $10 (30min)

### Kids
- Kids wash & retwist: $65+ (1h 30min). Under 10 to 12. Upcharge if the child is having a difficult time.
- Kids interlocking: $90 (2h). Ages 10 to 12. Wash plus interlocking.
- Kids wash retwist & 2 strand twist: $90 (2h). Ages 10 to 12. Two strand rope twist after wash and palm roll.
- Kid style: $15 (15min). Add-on.

### Repairs
- Loc repair: $30+ (30min). Up to 5 locs: thinning, breaks, knots, splits or part correction. Full head $150 (2h).
- Loc reattachment repairs: $30+ (30min). Up to 5 reattachments. Bring your detached pieces.
- Loc reattachments full head: $700+ (4h). Current hair must be 3 inches.
- Crotchet retighten: $200+ (2h 30min). Above-shoulder start.
- Combining locs by crotchet: $500+ (4h). Consult required.
- Fillers: $300+ (3h). Thickens and blends slipping loc extensions.
- Loc half head reattachments: $400+ (4h). Half head, sides shaved.
- Curly ends: $300+ (4h). Human-hair curl tips on established locs.

### Add-ons & Treatments
- Elaborate updo: $50 (45min). Styles needing more than one technique.
- Two strand twist locs: $40+ (30min)
- Petals: $30 (30min). One petal bun or bang.
- Roller curls: $40 (1h). Hard or flexi rods.
- Quick style: $25 (30min). Simple styles under 15 minutes.
- Shampoo only: $25 (30min)
- Hair sprinkles: $20 (15min). Temporary beading, up to 3 locs.
- Aloe scrub: $25 (15min). Pure aloe moisturizer for locs.
- Citrus bath: $25 (30min)
- Undercut Hair Prep: $100+ (1h). Loc-extension top box only: cut, detox and prep for reinstall.
- Dandruff treatment: $30 (30min)
- Hot oil treatment: $35 (30min). For damaged, dry hair.
- Deep condition: $35 (30min). Detangles and softens.
- Loc trim: $10+ (10min)

### Braids
- Box braids on top of locs: $250 (3h). Shoulder-length start. Hair included.
- Crotchet braids: $150 (1h 30min)

### Color
- Permanent Hair color one solid color full head: $120 (1h)
- Permanent color grey cover: $60 (30min). Natural colors only.
- Temporary semi permanent color rinse: $30 (30min). Text your desired color. Lasts about 6 weeks.
- Hair style takedown: $20 (30min)

### Barber
- Male haircut: $25+ (40min)
- Female Haircut: $20+ (40min)
- Beard Shaping: $10+ (30min)
- Teen cut: $20 (30min). Ages 12 to 17.
- Kid cut: $15+ (30min). Ages 4 to 11. Price varies by behavior.
- Edge- Line up: $15+ (30min)
- Eyebrows: $7 (15min). Eyebrow cleanup.

### Education
- 1 on 1 loc class: $500 (4h). This is a hands on class with Lubby. Covers starter locs, parting, maintenance, repairs, styling and products.
- Loc styling: $75 (1h). Styling lesson: fishtail braids, loc knot bobs, petal buns and more.

### Policies
- Deposit: $25 (5min). Required at booking or the appointment is declined. Deducted from your total at checkout. Non-refundable for cancellation, no-show or lateness.
- Inconvenience fee: $40 (30min). If you arrive needing services you did not book, they may be declined or charged $40 for about 30 minutes of extra time.

## FAQ

Q: How do I book an appointment at Lubby's Locs?
A: Book online on Booksy, where you can see live availability. A $25 deposit is required to hold your appointment and is deducted from your total at checkout. You can also call or text (813) 520-1648.

Q: I'm new. Which appointment should I book?
A: Book the New client appointment ($115, about 2 hours 15 minutes). It includes an introduction to Lubby's Locs, a complete consultation and recommendations, plus a wash, condition, palm-roll retwist and basic style. If you only want to talk through a plan first, book the $30 Consultation.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Hours change week to week, so the best way to see open times is live availability on Booksy. For an appointment during closed hours, call or text; there is a $25 non-refundable convenience fee deposit for after-hours appointments.

Q: How much is a retwist?
A: On Booksy, a Retwist locs box top is $70, a Wash + Retwist full head shoulders up is $90, mid back is $100, and Wash, retwist and two strand rope twist starts at $130.

Q: What happens if I'm running late?
A: If you are 15 minutes or more late without texting or calling, you may be asked to reschedule and forfeit your deposit. A quick text helps.

Q: Do you do kids' locs and haircuts?
A: Yes. Kids wash and retwist starts at $65, kids interlocking is $90, and the barber menu includes kid cuts from $15, teen cuts at $20 and men's cuts from $25.

Q: Can you repair or reattach my locs?
A: Yes. Loc repair starts at $30 for up to 5 locs (full head $150), reattachments start at $30 for up to 5, and larger work like crochet retightening, combining and fillers is priced on Booksy and at consultation.

Q: Is there parking and is the salon accessible?
A: Booksy lists parking, wheelchair access, Wi-Fi, a child-friendly space, credit card payments and a loyalty program at 1323 W Busch Blvd, Suite D.

Q: Can I buy the hair butter or bonnets?
A: Yes. Hair Butter, Growth Oil, durags, bonnets and a loc stocking cap are on the Lubby's Locs shop page, with checkout on her secure Square store.
